TextFileProcessor.read_file_as_json:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Opens the file at the instance's configured path, parses its entire contents as JSON, and returns the resulting Python object." read_file_as_json]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance providing file_path, the path to the JSON file to read"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> data </REF>: any "Python object deserialized from the JSON file contents"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Open the file at self.file_path in read mode and bind it to the local variable file RESULT file]
            [COMMAND Parse the entire contents of file as JSON and assign the resulting Python object to data RESULT data]
            [COMMAND Return data to the caller RESULT return]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]

    [END_INPUTS]

    [END_OUTPUTS]

            [COMMAND Open the file at self.file_path in write mode ('w'), which creates the file if it does not exist and truncates it if it does RESULT file_handle]

    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
TextFileProcessor.process_file:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads a file's contents, strips all non-alphabetic characters (retaining Unicode letters in their original order), writes the filtered string back to the file, and returns it." process_file]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> content </REF>: str "The filtered string containing only alphabetic characters (Unicode-aware) from the original file, in original order."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.read_file() and assign the returned raw file contents string to content. RESULT content]
            [COMMAND Reassign content by iterating over every character in content, keeping only those characters for which str.isalpha() returns True (Unicode-aware: passes letters from any script, not just ASCII), then joining the surviving characters with an empty separator via ''.join(...). RESULT content]
            [COMMAND Call self.write_file(content) to persist the filtered alphabetic-only string to the file. RESULT None]
            [COMMAND Return content to the caller. RESULT content]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.read_file() returns an empty string]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND The list comprehension over an empty string produces an empty list; ''.join([]) yields an empty string, so content is assigned '' unconditionally. RESULT content]
            [COMMAND Call self.write_file('') to write an empty string to the file. RESULT None]
            [COMMAND Return '' to the caller. RESULT content]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The file contains no alphabetic characters (all digits, whitespace, punctuation, etc.)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND The isalpha() filter rejects every character; ''.join([]) yields '', so content is assigned ''. RESULT content]
            [COMMAND Call self.write_file('') and return ''. RESULT content]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: self.read_file() raises an exception (e.g., I/O error, encoding error)]
        [LOG "Exception propagates from self.read_file() before any assignment to content; the filter step and self.write_file() are never reached."]
        [THROW PropagatedIOException "The exception raised by self.read_file() is not caught and propagates to the caller unchanged."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: self.write_file(content) raises an exception after filtering succeeds]
        [LOG "Exception propagates from self.write_file(); the return statement is never reached even though content holds the correct filtered value."]
        [THROW PropagatedWriteException "The exception raised by self.write_file() is not caught and propagates to the caller unchanged."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
